verses: To the chief Musician, of David. The fool has said in his heart, There is no God. They are corrupt, they have done abominable works, there is none that does good.
The Lord looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that understood, and sought God.
They are all gone aside, they are all together become filthy: there is none that does good, no, not one.
Have all the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread, and call not upon the Lord.
There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.
You shame the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.
Oh that the salvation of Yisra᾽el were come out of Żiyyon! when the Lord brings back the captivity of his people, Ya῾aqov shall rejoice, and Yisra᾽el shall be glad.
